g.text: Multi-Agent Disaster Response Coordination & Optimization Engine
• Dynamic Priority Mapping: P1, P2, P3, P4
• Free OSM Vector Tiles (No Token Needed)
• Sub-10ms Cosine Similarity Search for multi-source report deduplication
• In-memory file storage (./qdrant_data) with server cluster fallback
• SQLAlchemy Async ORM with complete audit trail (AuditLog, RawIngestionRecord)
• Responder Registry: real-time team location, operational capacity, team types
• CommunicationLog: timestamped SMS delivery status & lifecycle transitions

svg.text: DisasterMesh: Built with FastAPI, LangGraph, Qdrant, Google OR-Tools, Textual TUI & Next.js 14
